meta.promptText: Mujhe aisa sunscreen kharidna hai jo Indian skin par white cast na chhode. Konsa best hai?

response.text:
Indian skin tones (jo ki melanin-rich hote hain) par kuch mineral sunscreens chalky ya ashy white cast chhod dete hain. Is problem se bachne ke liye **chemical** ya **lightweight hybrid gel/fluid sunscreens** sabse best hote hain jo skin mein ekdum seamlessly absorb ho jaate hain.

Yahan kuch top-rated sunscreens hain jo Indian skin par bilkul **white cast nahi chhodte**:

Oily aur acne-prone skin ke liye ye ek **cult favorite** hai. Iska dry-touch matte finish hai aur yeh deep Indian skin tones par bhi **bilkul white cast nahi chhodta**.

Yeh aqua-gel formula **hyaluronic acid** ke sath aata hai, jo skin ko hydrate rakhta hai aur bina kisi sticky residue ke turant absorb ho jata hai.

Agar aapko dewy aur natural glow pasand hai, toh rice water aur niacinamide se bani yeh sunscreen skin ko bright banate hue zero white cast deti hai.

Yeh Dr. Sheth's Haldi & Hyaluronic Acid Sunscreen specially Indian skin ki zarooraton ko dhyan mein rakh kar banai gayi hai, jo blue light aur UV rays se protection dete hue skin par easily blend ho jati hai.
